texto: **Camminando, ho visto Anna** (as I walked, I saw Anna); **Ha passato la serata leggendo** (spent the night reading).
The subject of the gerunde is usually the same as the subject of the main prayer.
**Essendo in ritardo, ho preso un taxi** (as I was late, I took a taxi). The pronoun is postponed: **leggendolo** (reading it), **chiedendoglielo** (asking it).
It avoids leaving the implicit subject of the gerunde unreferred.

filas: Leggendo il rapporto, ho preso appunti.
As I read it, I took notes.
He learned by watching his companions.
Since it was late, we left.
When I read it, I noticed a mistake.

intro: The gerunde may indicate simultaneous actions, mode or cause. If it has an atone pronoun, it is joined at the end: **leggendolo**.
